param: collection_name (alias resolution on the describe face)

oracle.statement: describe by a live alias = 200 whose result.config.params.vectors.size equals the current alias target's created size (4 before the atomic switch, 8 after); 404 on a live alias or a 200 naming the wrong target's size = Type4; after the alias is deleted, describe by the alias name = exactly 404 with a non-empty error message (200-with-config = Type1, bare 404 = Type4); A and B keep answering 200 with sizes 4/8 throughout; 5xx = Type3 only with /healthz liveness
